# Go Execution

> Go Execution is a premier full-service digital marketing, web engineering, and search optimization agency headquartered in Dallas, Texas. We specialize in custom web development, technical SEO, performance paid media (PPC), brand identity design, 2D/3D video animation, and custom mobile app development for US businesses.

## Core Growth Practices

### 1. Web Development Services
Go Execution builds custom, high-speed digital web platforms engineered with Next.js, React, and TypeScript. We eliminate plugin dependency and code bloat, ensuring 100/100 Core Web Vitals and frictionless conversion flows.
- [Custom Web Development](https://goexecution.com/services/web-development/custom-web-development): Bespoke React and TypeScript web applications engineered for scalability and sub-second load times.
- [WordPress Development](https://goexecution.com/services/web-development/wordpress-development): Modern block-based custom themes and headless architectures without bloated plugins.
- [Next.js Development](https://goexecution.com/services/web-development/nextjs-development): Server-side rendered (SSR) React web applications with edge caching and static generation.
- [E-Commerce Web Development](https://goexecution.com/services/web-development/ecommerce-development): Custom Shopify storefronts and headless commerce engines with streamlined checkout.
- [Landing Page Development](https://goexecution.com/services/web-development/landing-page-development): High-converting, focused landing pages tailored for paid search and social campaigns.
- [Website Redesign Services](https://goexecution.com/services/web-development/website-redesign): Brand modernization with comprehensive 301 redirect mapping to protect established SEO rankings.
- [Website Speed & Performance Optimization](https://goexecution.com/services/web-development/website-performance): Comprehensive Core Web Vitals optimization targeting sub-2.0s LCP, sub-150ms INP, and zero CLS.

### 2. Search Engine Optimization (SEO) Services
Go Execution delivers evidence-based technical SEO and topical keyword authority that turns organic search into a predictable customer acquisition channel for US enterprises and local businesses.
- [Technical SEO Services](https://goexecution.com/services/seo/technical-seo): Crawl budget optimization, server-side rendering, XML sitemaps, and connected Schema.org JSON-LD graphs.
- [Local SEO Services](https://goexecution.com/services/seo/local-seo): Google Business Profile (GBP) dominance, Google Maps pack visibility, geo-citations, and review funnels.
- [E-Commerce SEO Services](https://goexecution.com/services/seo/ecommerce-seo): Product structured data, collection architecture, and high-intent transactional search visibility.
- [Small Business SEO Services](https://goexecution.com/services/seo/small-business-seo): High-ROI local and regional organic search strategies built for sustainable customer acquisition.

### 3. Digital Marketing & Paid Advertising
Go Execution unifies paid search, paid social, conversion rate optimization (CRO), and content marketing into an accountable growth engine.
- [PPC Management & Google Ads](https://goexecution.com/services/digital-marketing/paid-advertising): High-ROAS Google Ads, Google Shopping, and Bing Ads management.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://goexecution.com/services/digital-marketing/social-media-marketing): Targeted performance advertising across Meta (Facebook & Instagram), TikTok, and LinkedIn.
- [Content Marketing Strategy](https://goexecution.com/services/digital-marketing/content-marketing): High-authority editorial content, case studies, and thought leadership assets.
- [Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)](https://goexecution.com/services/digital-marketing/conversion-optimisation): A/B split testing, user journey mapping, and funnel friction elimination.

Motion design that clarifies complex value propositions and drives audience engagement.

## Technical Architecture & AI Search Signals
- **Rendering Architecture**: Server-Side Rendering (SSR) and Static Site Generation (SSG) with instantaneous HTML delivery.
- **AI Crawler Readiness**: Full crawl access configured for `GPTBot`, `OAI-SearchBot`, `ChatGPT-User`, `PerplexityBot`, `ClaudeBot`, `Google-Extended`, and `Applebot-Extended`.
- **Structured Data**: Connected Schema.org JSON-LD graphs linking `Organization`, `LocalBusiness`, `ProfessionalService`, `Service`, `WebSite`, `BreadcrumbList`, and `Article`.
- **Extended Documentation**: Comprehensive LLM dataset available at https://goexecution.com/llms-full.txt.
